diagrams.title: How the pieces connect
diagrams.note: Built: the shared rules package (core_domain) and the counter app with its local database (encrypted with SQLCipher; the Windows runtime is unverified): sign-in, stock entry with hangtag printing, billing register, returns and credit notes, shifts with the blind cash close, the daybook and the owner's daily report. Not built: backups, installer, GST setup, pay later, sync, cloud, mobile app. Dashed lines are release 2.

diagrams.title: What happens in one sale
diagrams.note: Built: scanning, cashier-safe lookup, pricing, the discount limit with manager approval, payment and change, credit notes, the bill number, an open shift, and the one local transaction that marks garments SOLD and writes the bill, daybook rows, audit and outbox. The daybook feeds the shift close and the owner's daily report. Not built: pay later, receipts other than A4.
